recipes.title: Torrent activity watcher
recipes.summary: Watch a selected torrent executable for new remote TCP endpoints. UDP sends are not yet visible.

recipes.title: Timed torrent pause
recipes.summary: Preemptively restrict a selected torrent executable for a reviewed duration.

recipes.title: App network activity watcher
recipes.summary: Notify when a selected app first appears with a non-loopback remote TCP endpoint. Direction and attempted connections are unknown with snapshots.

recipes.title: Reactive app block
recipes.summary: Notify and temporarily restrict an app after supported outbound activity; initial traffic may already have passed.
recipes.requires: Lifecycle events and privileged temporary-restriction collector

recipes.title: Unexpected document-app networking
recipes.summary: Watch an explicitly selected document application's remote TCP endpoint appearances; legitimate updates may also trigger it.
recipes.requires: Exact Word, Excel, or PDF-reader executable path

recipes.title: Large upload in a short window
recipes.summary: Alert on a covered transmit-byte threshold; do not treat a burst as proof of data theft.
recipes.requires: Reliable per-flow transmit deltas and incident recorder

recipes.title: New non-loopback TCP listener
recipes.summary: Watch a selected executable for a new TCP binding beyond loopback. This does not prove external reachability.

recipes.title: Destination allowlist
recipes.summary: Alert when selected apps contact an address outside reviewed IPv4/IPv6 CIDRs.
recipes.requires: Lifecycle or UDP events and CIDR policy

recipes.title: VPN-bound app investigation
recipes.summary: Detect confirmed egress on an unapproved interface; predicted routes alone are advisory.

recipes.title: Repeated connection failures
recipes.summary: Alert on explicit failure events in a covered time window; snapshot disappearance is not a failure.
